(Combo) After using Annihilan Strike: Your next Oblivion triggers no cooldown.

800220.name: Taskmaster's Army
800220.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Infernal Whipcrack by -30 sec and it now affects all allies and its radius is increased by 15 yds.

800222.name: The Demon Within
800222.desc: If you reach 6 Felfury, you will consume it to enter Demon Form for 0.@ext::ext@

800225.name: Skull of Gul'dan
800225.desc: Consume the essence of the skull of Gul'dan, increasing your maximum health and Energy by 20% for 10 seconds.

800239.name: Fragment of Malice
800239.desc: Restores 5 Energy and increases your critical strike chance by 10% for 5 sec.

800353.name: Consume Magic
800353.desc: Steal 1 beneficial magic effects from an enemy. If you successfully steal an effect, you deal 8 Shadow Damage to the enemy.

800355.name: Sargeras Embrace
800355.desc: Channel a beam of fel magic upon an enemy, slowing your target's movement speed by -60% for 5.5 seconds and dealing cond(gt(SPFI, SPS), 695+9.55+SPFI*0.85, 695+9.55+SPS*0.85) Shadowflame Damage at the end of the duration. For the duration, you may instant cast Fel Fireball and Ruin while channeling and they refund their cost.

800707.name: Demon Form (Slaying)
800707.desc: Demon Form now grants 10% increased Physical Damage done.

801024.name: Add 2 Felfury
801024.desc: 2 Charges 5 sec recharge Jump in the air with forward momentum. Not usable in combat.

801164.name: Spectral Glaive
801164.desc: Deals 50 Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

801208.name: Demon Form (Felblood)
801208.desc: Demon Form now grants increased spell power equal 20% of your Intellect.

801239.name: Gust
801239.desc: Requires Fel Empowerment Deal 339 Chaos Damage to 0 enemies in a 12 yd cone, reducing magic resistance by 15% for 10 sec.

801312.name: Fel Fireball
801312.desc: Generates 1 Felfury Unleash a powerful fel fireball at an enemy, dealing 64.5 Fire damage. Inner Demon: Unleashes a Felstrke on your target, dealing 0 Chaos damage over 6 sec, stacking 3 times. Usable while moving.

801890.name: Felstrikes
801890.desc: Some of your offensive abilities can trigger a Felstrike on an enemy target.

801892.name: Twin Fury
801892.desc: Critically striking with Twin Slice now generates an additional 1 Felfury.

801894.name: Pure Hatred
801894.desc: Your Hateforged Barrier now also scales with your maximum health.

801895.name: Ruin
801895.desc: Consumes 2 Felfury Bring doom upon an enemy, dealing cond(gt(SPFI, SPS), 116+16.7+SPFI*1, 116+16.7+SPS*1.32) Shadowflame Damage to an enemy, piercing all absorption effects. Inner Demon: Deals an additional 30% of the damage dealt over 3 seconds.

801896.name: Vengeance
801896.desc: Take vengeance upon up to 0 enemies in a 5 yd frontal cone, dealing 142.6 Chaos Damage and triggering 2 Felstrikes. (Combo] After using Vengeance: Twin Slice costs no energy. (Combo) After using Vengeance: Stomp heals you for 10% of your maximum health.

801899.name: Legionfall
801899.desc: Increases the chance for Azzinoth's Assault to not consume Felfury while Inner Demon is active by -5%.

801901.name: Twin Slice
801901.desc: Generates 1 Felfury Strike with both weapons for 240% Weapon Damage plus 6 with each strike.

801903.name: Annihilan Strike
801903.desc: Generates 2 Felfury Unleash a devastating attack, dealing 145% Weapon Damage to your target with both weapons. This ability is guaranteed to critically strike against enemies above 75% health.

801904.name: Azzinoth's Assault
801904.desc: Consumes 2 Felfury Strike an enemy for Weapon Damage plus 15 + 10% AP to an enemy with both of your weapons, additionally scaling with your attack power.

801914.name: Annihilan Strike (Offhand)
801914.desc: Unleash a devastating attack, dealing 0% Weapon Damage to your target with both weapons. This ability is guaranteed to critically strike against enemies above 75% health.

802059.name: Annihilation
802059.desc: Launch chaotic magic at an enemy over 2.5 sec, dealing 1 Chaos Damage every 0.5 sec. Your Energy regeneration is increased by 100% for the duration. Usable while moving. Inner Demon: Grants you Sculptor of Doom. @ext::ext@

802060.name: Sargeron Smite
802060.desc: Consumes 2 Felfury Blast an enemy for 11.59 Shadowflame Damage and generate 20 Energy. Inner Demon: This spell casts an additional time free of cost.

802075.name: Blood of Mannoroth
802075.desc: Generates 6 Felfury Soak in the blood of Mannoroth, increasing your Energy regeneration by 100%, and causes you to ignore all enemy armor for 20 sec.

802076.name: Pit Lord's Strength
802076.desc: Your Annihilation now affects 1 additional attack.

802108.name: Hidden Power
802108.desc: Level 20 Passive Increases your spell damage by 15% of your Intellect and Spirit. In addition, Inner Demon now increases your spell damage and critical strike chance by an additional 20% of your Spirit.

802180.name: Fel Cannon
802180.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Fel Fireball and Ruin by 15% on enemies above 75% health.

802676.name: Chaos
802676.desc: Unleash an immense amount of felfire at an enemy, dealing 13 Fire Damage.

802678.name: Felstrike
802678.desc: Burn an enemy for 294000 Shadowflame Damage over 6 sec, stacking 3 times.

802692.name: Fel Smite
802692.desc: Burn an enemy for 1312000 Shadowflame Damage over 4 sec, healing for 0% of the damage dealt and generates 20 Energy. Scales with modifiers to Sargeron Smite.

802899.name: Twin Slice UNUSED
802899.desc: Deals 0 bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

803343.name: Slayer's Pact
803343.desc: Emanate an aura that increases the mounted movement speed of nearby allies by 20%. Only 1 Pact can be active per player at a time.

803467.name: Sargeron Smite (Inner Demon)
803467.desc: Consumes 2 Felfury Blast an enemy for 0.19 Shadowflame Damage and generate 20 Energy. Inner Demon: Casts an additional time on your target free of cost.

803488.name: Dreadlord's Pact
803488.desc: Emanate an aura that causes nearby allies to heal themselves equal to 2% of all direct damage and healing done by them. This effect is increased to 10% for you. Only 1 Pact can be active per player at a time.

803496.name: Fel Resistance
803496.desc: Each Felfury active now reduces your periodic damage taken by 5%.

803645.name: Unphased
803645.desc: Level 40 Passive Increases your spell penetration by 60, scaling with your level. In addition, reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 50% while Inner Demon is active.

803714.name: Twin Slice Test
803714.desc: Strike with both weapons dealing 0% Weapon Damage plus 0 Physical Damage. (Combo) After using Twin Slice: Transform this ability into Dancing Blades

803903.name: Fel Haze
803903.desc: While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.

803905.name: Shadow Magi
803905.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Annihilation by -15 sec.

804052.name: Eye of Archimonde
804052.desc: Instantly reveals all stealthed and invisible enemies in a 30 yd radius around you.

804216.name: Inner Demon
804216.desc: Consumes Felfury Undergo a metamorphosis and unleash your inner demon, increasing your damage dealt by 10%, reducing damage taken by 5%, increasing melee attack speed by 15%, and enabling Inner Demon effects. Lasts for 5 sec for each Felfury consumed.

804218.name: Demonscale
804218.desc: Demon Form now boosts Armor and Magic Resistance based on Dodge Rating. It also increases healing received by 0%, and threat generation by 0%.

804219.name: Infernal Doom
804219.desc: Ruin now has a -25% chance not to consume Felfury.

804220.name: Betray
804220.desc: Taunts an enemy target to attack you for 3 sec. Inner Demon: Blast the enemy for 50% of Attack Power Shadowflame Damage.

804291.name: Burning Vengeance
804291.desc: Increases threat generation by 600% and causes Demon Form to activate for free when in combat but reduces damage dealt by 0%. Reaching 100 rage now blasts nearby enemies for 1 Shadowflame Damage.

804522.name: Soar
804522.desc: Launch yourself into the air where you will linger for 10 sec. While Soar is active, Fel Fireball is instant but deals 40% less damage.

804610.name: Reckless Assault
804610.desc: Increases the damage of Azzinoth's Assault and Twin Slice by 15% against slowed enemies.

804611.name: Azzinoth's Rage
804611.desc: Increases your Armor penetration by 10% and your expertise by 4.

804615.name: Demonic Attunement
804615.desc: Increases the damage of your Ragefire by 15%. @ext::ext@

804758.name: Betrayer's Inclinations
804758.desc: Knowledge of demonkind allows you to track your kin, showing the location of all nearby Demons on the minimap. While active, your attacks against Demons have a 10% chance to deliver a Betrayer's Blow, dealing 25 Physical Damage and stunning the target for 2 sec.

804764.name: Legionfel Pact
804764.desc: Emanate an aura that increases nearby allies' Fire resistance by 52.8 and their chance to resist curses and magic effects by 15%.

804766.name: Betrayer's Blow
804766.desc: Causes weapon damage plus 25 to 26 to a Demon and stuns it for 2 sec.

804822.name: Vengeance Is Mine
804822.desc: Dodging or parrying an attack now gives you a 10% chance to make your next 10 instances of damage with Twin Slice deal 30% increased damage and generate 1 Felfury.

804823.name: Tyrannical Resolve
804823.desc: Taunt enemies within 8 yds for 4 seconds and ignore -50% of all damage taken for 30 seconds, up to 100% of your maximum health. When this ends, you unleash a Felfire Blast that leeches health from nearby enemies based on how many times you took damage with the effect active.

804824.name: Tyrant's Rage
804824.desc: The Felfire Blast that occurs when Tyranny expires deals 20% increased damage.

804825.name: Felfire Blast
804825.desc: Deals 175.2 to 176.2 Felfire Damage to nearby enemies.

805235.name: Whispers of the Pit
805235.desc: Unleash fel energy upon enemies at target location, fearing them and slowing their movement speed by -80% for 8 seconds. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

805240.name: Tyrant's Gaze
805240.desc: Set your fiery gaze upon an enemy and all enemies in front of you, intimidating them and causing them to combust, dealing 344 + 35% AP Shadowflame Damage to them. Damaging an enemy in this way heals you for 323 + 50% AP and generates 1 Felfury. Only usable on enemies below 35% health.

805243.name: Infernal Whipcrack
805243.desc: Enrage up to 8 allies within 20 yds, reducing their damage taken by -15% and increasing their haste by 10% for 10 seconds.

805246.name: Hulking Demon
805246.desc: Level 20 Passive Increases your attack power by 30% of your Stamina and your hit rating by 6% of your Agility.

805248.name: Manaburn
805248.desc: Burn an enemy's mana equal to 150% of your Stamina. Deals damage equal to the mana drained.

805251.name: Trampling Hooves
805251.desc: While in Demon Form, your Felhoof Charge has a 9 sec reduced Cooldown. In addition, it now Roots the target for 2 sec at all times.

806103.name: Wrath of Sargeras
806103.desc: Increases your Magic Damage dealt by 3% and your spell hit chance by 2%.

806109.name: Illidan's Guile
806109.desc: Gorge on fel energy, becoming immune to all physical attacks and spells for 8 seconds, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells. At the end of the duration, your next Chaos Rush within 5 seconds now dashes an additional 20 yds.

806111.name: Demonic Machinations
806111.desc: Critical strikes with Sargeron Smite now cause the target to bleed for an additional 50% of the damage dealt over 5 seconds.

807022.name: Chaos Orb
807022.desc: Enter Tyrant Form for 15 sec, granting armor and magic resistance based on dodge rating. This form also reduces damage taken by 5% and significantly boosts all healing recieved.

807207.name: Fel Doom Summon
807207.desc: Enter Tyrant Form for 0, granting armor and magic resistance based on dodge rating. This form also reduces damage taken by 5% and significantly boosts all healing recieved.

807438.name: Demonic Blood
807438.desc: Generating Felfury now extends the duration of Inner Demon by 0.5 sec.

807461.name: Herald of the Legion
807461.desc: Damage dealt by Bane of Chaos now radiates fel energy around the enemy, dealing 50% of the damage dealt to up to 8 nearby enemies.

807649.name: Prolong Demonhood
807649.desc: Consumes Felfury Increases the duration of your Inner Demon by 5 sec for each Felfury consumed. Scales with modifiers to Inner Demon. Duration cannot exceed the current maximum duration of your Inner Demon.

807727.name: Agonizing Presence
807727.desc: Embolden yourself with fel magic, increasing your threat generated by 125%.

807942.name: Fel Bargain
807942.desc: Tap into deprave fel energies, exchanging Energy for health. Every 2 points of Energy restore 1% of your maximum health.

887002.name: CoA Aura - Felsworn Class
887002.desc: Tuning aura for Felsworn Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887027.name: CoA Aura - Felsworn - Slayer
887027.desc: Tuning aura for Felsworn - Slayer. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887028.name: CoA Aura - Felsworn - Infernal
887028.desc: Tuning aura for Felsworn - Infernal. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887029.name: CoA Aura - Felsworn - Tyrant
887029.desc: Tuning aura for Felsworn - Tyrant. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

900028.name: Glaive Rush copy
900028.desc: Dash forward 20 yds through enemies, dealing 1% Weapon Damage. Consecutive uses of this ability will reduce the distance dashed, up to 3 times. This ability is not usable while Rooted. If you use Felrend directly after this ability, it will Root all nearby enemies for 2 sec.

954534.name: Enslave Elemental
954534.desc: Enslave the target hostile elemental for up to 40 sec (8 sec vs players), forcing it to fight for you. Only one target can be enslaved at a time.
